## Description {#details}

<p>Main C++ header file with the declarations for the µOS++ lists classes.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-h">lists.h</a></span> header file contains the C++ declarations of the <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> classes, delivering an efficient and lightweight linked list management system tailored for embedded applications.</p>


<p>The classes implementations are in the <a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/src/lists-cpp">lists.cpp</a> and <a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-inlines-h">lists-inlines.h</a> files.</p>
